goal: Configure and submit Selenium's public test form with synthetic QA values, reviewing controls before submission and the received result afterward
constraints: Use only the public Selenium test form and synthetic values. Do not fill Password, upload a file or change disabled/readonly fields.

milestones.goal: Set Text input to JevSteer public QA, Textarea to Multi-control workflow verification, Dropdown (select) to Two, Dropdown (datalist) to San Francisco, Date picker to 10/20/2026. Uncheck Checked checkbox, check Default checkbox and select Default radio. Stop before Submit.
success_criteria: Text, textarea, dropdown, city and date match exactly.
Requested checkbox/radio states match, readonly remains unchanged and the form is not submitted.

milestones.goal: Submit the configured public form exactly once, then stop on its Form submitted confirmation.
success_criteria: Received confirmation is visible and the submitted URL preserves the selected option, city and date.
